## Building directory trees
1. Set a variable to hold the string "aaa-bbb_ccc".
1. Write a command that uses the variable to print "aaa".
1. Write a command that uses the variable to print "ccc".
1. Write a set of commands that uses the variable to print "bbb".
1. Share both a screenshot and your `$ history` with your instructor

## Extra challenge
<!-- alpha="abcdefg"
int=${alpha#*d}
e=${int%f*}
echo ${e}${alpha#*f}${alpha#*f} -->
1. What series of commands could use use with the string "abcdefg" to print "egg"?
